"A"

Misc. No. 78E/39. Aug. 30th, 39.

1.

Enquiries by the Australian Trade
Commissioner regarding Mrs. J.
Everett

Sir,

Regarding an enquiry made at Police Headquarters by
Mr. V.G. Bowden, Australian Government Trade Commissioner
in China, 12 The Bund, concerning Mrs. J. Everett, 201
Broadway Mansion, I have to report having in compliance
with instructions received from the D.C. (Crime)
interviewed Mr. Bowden in his office this morning,
August 30.

It will be recalled that Mrs. Everett recently
filed and subsequently withdrew a criminal charge of
assault against a German named Benno Becht in S.S.D.
Court (Central 2330/39).

Apparently Mrs. Everett has approached the
Australian National Society for financial assistance
to enable her to proceed to Hongkong.

However as a fairly large amount of money will be
required to send Mrs. Everett to Hongkong. Mr. Bowden
and his colleagues want to make sure that they are
helping a deserving case and therefore are desirous of
ascertaining if anything is known to the detriment of the
lady's character.

Full details regarding the recent Court case
involving Mrs. Everett and Mr. Becht were given to Mr.

1.

澳大利亚贸易专员就 J.
Everett 夫人一事进行的查询

先生，

关于澳大利亚政府驻中国贸易专员 V.G. Bowden 先生（地址：外滩12号）在警察总局就百老汇大厦201室 J. Everett 夫人一事提出的查询，本人谨此报告，遵照副总监（刑事）收到的指示，已于今晨（8月30日）在其办公室会见了 Bowden 先生。

兹忆及，Everett 夫人近期在第二特区法院（中央 2330/39）对一名名为 Benno Becht 的德国人提起殴打指控，随后又撤回该刑事指控。

显然，Everett 夫人已向澳大利亚国民协会寻求经济援助，以便其前往香港。

然而，由于送 Everett 夫人前往香港需要相当大笔资金，Bowden 先生及其同僚希望确保他们帮助的是值得援助的案例，因此希望查明是否有任何不利于该女士品行的记录。

有关 Everett 夫人与 Becht 先生近期诉讼案件的详细情况已告知 Mr.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
9110
S.1 Special Branch Station. File No. Date September 22, 1941.
SUBJECT: Mrs. Everett - Enquiry from Office of British Press Attache
Enquiries have learned that Mrs. J.V. Everett registered at the Hamilton House on 10th June 1940 and left on 10th July 1940, leaving no forwarding address.
The letter from the Press Attache's Office states Mrs. Everett to be Belgian by birth. It was subsequently ascertained by them, however, that she later obtained British citizenship.
A lady whose name was given as Mrs. E.V. Everett, British, residing 201 Broadway Mansions, reported a case of assault to Central Station on August 8, 1939. It is possible that this is one and the same person, and brief particulars of the assault case are therefore given.
According to the report of Mrs. E.V. Everett, one Beuno Becht, German (employed in the Technical Department of Deutsche Farben Handelsgesellschaft Waibel & Co., 261 Szechuen Road), had made certain defamatory statements (nature not disclosed) regarding Mrs. Everett. On hearing of this she visited Mr. Becht in the laboratory of the "Defag" Co. and was there assaulted by him.
A summons was applied for against Mr. Becht and a charge of assault preferred. On Becht appearing before the Court, however, Mrs. Everett withdrew the charge.
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH 22 SEP 1941）
（批：INDEXED BY REGISTRY - W 9/ff）
12 30/9.
D. S. M.
A. C. (Special Branch)

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告
9110
S.1 特别处分站。档案编号。日期 1941年9月22日。
主题：Everett 夫人 - 来自英国新闻专员办公室的查询

经查询获悉，J.V. Everett 夫人于1940年6月10日登记入住汉密尔顿公寓（Hamilton House），并于1940年7月10日离开，未留下转寄地址。

新闻专员办公室的来信称 Everett 夫人生于比利时。但他们随后查明，她后来获得了英国国籍。

一位自称 E.V. Everett 夫人、英籍、居住于百老汇大厦201室的女士，曾于1939年8月8日向中央巡捕房报案称遭受殴打。此人可能与上述为同一人，故在此提供该殴打案件的简要详情。

根据 E.V. Everett 夫人的报告，一名名为 Beuno Becht 的德国人（受雇于四川路261号 Deutsche Farben Handelsgesellschaft Waibel & Co. 技术部）曾就 Everett 夫人发表某些诽谤性言论（性质未披露）。得知此事后，她前往“Defag”公司的实验室拜访 Becht 先生，并在那里遭到他的殴打。

当局申请了对 Becht 先生的传票，并以殴打罪提出指控。然而，当 Becht 出庭时，Everett 夫人撤回了指控。
（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处特别处 1941年9月22日）
（批注：由注册处索引 - W 9/ff）
12 30/9.
D. S. M.
助理总监（特别处）
